about: Every graphic in farm-legacy, drawn flat at 1920x1080. Positions are % of the frame (x from the left, y from the top). Times: 'src' = source film; cut30 / cut15 = the cut timelines. Composite these in post; never ask a video model to draw them.

ui_super.typeface: humanist sans, semibold, slightly rounded terminals (stand-in used: Avenir Next Demi Bold)

timeline.fade: opacity 0 -> 0.85 in the first 0.20 s, -> 1.0 by 0.67 s (ease-out); out with the picture cut, no fade

ui_end_card.background: set/loc_endcard_field.jpg, pushed 1.00 -> 1.04 over the card, linear, centred on the vanishing point (x 50%, y 8%)

layers.note: default generic mark: cream oval, dark-green rim (#2E6B3A), green sprout, 'POTATO CHIPS' in brown (#543018) rounded capitals

layers.words: Grown by families. Made for yours.

flash_into_memory.what: the white sun-flash that hides the cut from planting-now into planting-then
flash_into_memory.build: a soft warm-white bloom (#FFF4DC) from the upper right, screen blend: on the last two frames of shot 6 the frame average rises 82 -> 92 -> 112 (16.581, 16.623), hard cut at 16.665 into shot 7 at 144, peak 146 over 16.72-16.84, back to 92 by 17.14 (7 frames); no flare streaks
